textos.As reviews negativas criticam a duração: Negative reviews criticize the running time of more than seven hours, calling it unjustified and drawn out, with scenes that stretch on without purpose and could be cut drastically.
textos.Falta de conteúdo narrativo e tédio: Lack of narrative content and boredom
textos.Este grupo destaca que a história é vazi: This group stresses that the story is empty, with no meaningful development, and that boredom prevails, with long stretches in which nothing happens.
textos.Várias reviews negativas condenam uma ce: Several negative reviews condemn a scene involving an animal, considered cruel and unnecessary, which harms the experience and provokes disgust.
textos.As críticas apontam que os personagens s: The reviews point out that the characters are apathetic and poorly developed, and that the performances feel artificial or unconvincing.
textos.Algumas reviews mencionam que o roteiro: Some reviews mention that the script is confusing, with a nonlinear structure that adds nothing, and that the adaptation of the book turns out unsatisfying and inferior to the original work.
textos.Este grupo enxerga o filme como pretensi: This group sees the film as pretentious, accusing the work and its admirers of elitism and of overvaluing content they consider empty.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas criticam a exten: Many middling reviews criticize the seven-hour length, considering it excessive and unnecessary, with several stretches that could be shortened without loss.
textos.O ritmo vagaroso é apontado como um test: The slow pace is described as a test of patience, with prolonged shots that make the experience exhausting for a portion of the audience.
textos.A fotografia em preto e branco e a compo: The black-and-white cinematography and the visual composition are praised, creating a striking, immersive atmosphere even when the pace is slow.
textos.A ambientação opressiva e melancólica da: The oppressive, melancholic setting of the Hungarian village is highlighted as a strength, effectively conveying desolation and isolation.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas mencionam dific: Some middling reviews mention difficulty following the story, with subplots that seem to lead nowhere and a lack of clarity about the characters' goals.
textos.A presença de uma cena envolvendo um gat: The presence of a scene involving a cat is criticized by some as uncomfortable and potentially cruel, causing discomfort during the screening.
textos.A longa duração de sete horas e meia e o: The long running time of seven and a half hours and the deliberately slow pace are seen as essential to the immersive experience, although some consider it could be shortened without losing impact.
textos.A fotografia em preto e branco e os exte: The black-and-white cinematography and the extended long takes are widely praised for their beauty and for their ability to create a hypnotic, contemplative atmosphere.
textos.A ambientação melancólica e a representa: The melancholic setting and the depiction of poverty and abandonment are highlighted as central to the work, conveying a sense of desolation and stagnation.
textos.A narrativa não linear, dividida em capí: The nonlinear narrative, divided into chapters that intertwine and revisit the same events from different perspectives, is seen as a bold choice that reinforces the idea of cycles and repetition.
textos.A sequência envolvendo um gato é frequen: The sequence involving a cat is frequently mentioned as disturbing and hard to watch, causing discomfort, although some clarify that the animal was not harmed.
textos.A capacidade do filme de hipnotizar e im: The film's ability to hypnotize and immerse the viewer is emphasized, making one lose track of time and feel part of that world.

textos.aprecia fotografia em preto e branco com: appreciate black-and-white cinematography with extended long takes and a hypnotic atmosphere

textos.se cansa de narrativas extremamente long: get tired of extremely long narratives with a drawn-out pace and prolonged scenes

textos.Lançado em 1994 e dirigido por Béla Tarr: Released in 1994 and directed by Béla Tarr, the drama Satantango follows the residents of a small Hungarian village who deal with the aftermath of the local factory's closure after the end of communism. Expecting to receive a cash payment, the community is surprised by the return of a former resident who proposes the creation of a collective commune.
textos.A experiência da obra é estruturada a pa: The experience of the work is built on a long running time and a measured, slow rhythm, driven by continuous shots and black-and-white cinematography. The setting portrays a constant scene of desolation, decay and rural isolation.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~88%), a ma: In the vast majority of ratings (~88%), most stress that the extended running time and slow pace help deepen immersion in the narrative. Within this same set, about half praise the cinematography and the long takes, while a good portion emphasize the construction of an oppressive atmosphere and the depiction of misery.
textos.Para o grupo situado numa fração mínima: For the group sitting at a minimal fraction of ratings (~7%), the experience is seen in a divided way. Nearly all point to the excessive length as an obstacle and about half criticize the slow, drawn-out pace, even though a significant share keeps its praise for the cinematography and aesthetics.
textos.Por fim, sob a perspectiva de uma fração: Finally, from the perspective of an even smaller fraction of ratings (~5%), discontent stands out: practically all condemn the excessive length and the slow pace. On top of that, most complain about the lack of narrative content and the boredom, while several reject the inclusion of an animal scene as cruel.
